scope: Exactly these edits in test_run_records.py: the parameter ("straße@x.org", "STRASSE@x.org") becomes ("JÜRGEN@X.ORG", "jÜrgen@x.org"); test_a_fold_that_decomposes_is_still_one_owner becomes test_a_decomposed_character_is_still_one_owner, asserting NFC equivalence of a composed and a decomposed "ΐ" instead of casefold equivalence of "ΐ" and "Ϊ́".
reason: E5 P1 spec D6 (owner decision 2026-11-05, PR #1634 review): the owner key lowercases ASCII only, because Unicode case folding merges distinct addresses (ß/ss, ﬁ/fi, the Kelvin sign/k) into one owner, and the key is the only check on every Run read and write. The two edited cases asserted that folding.
